summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for the 8 Manager Dashboard changes. Backend: 19/19 pytest passing (13 regression + 6 new for /api/settings GET/PUT, MenuItem.images backfill, optional category/emoji, multi-image PUT). Frontend Playwright: 18/18 checks passing — login counter hidden, PIN digits-only max 10, sidebar shows full text labels, topbar clock is HH:MM AM/PM (1 colon, AM/PM token), Menu form has no category/emoji, multi-photo upload (2 thumbs + remove buttons), Cancel button clears form & restores 'Add New Item' header, item persists with both images, every order row has Bill button opening BillModal with Subtotal/CGST/SGST/TOTAL, Settings page has all fields with GST rate options 0/5/12/18, Save persists via PUT /api/settings and BillModal reflects new restaurant_name + GST split within ~2s auto-refresh.

issues: Clock renders lowercase 'am/pm' (toLocaleTimeString default on this runtime). Spec/data says 'AM/PM' uppercase; cosmetic only — pass hour12:true with explicit options or .toUpperCase() if uppercase desired.
React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from a select option somewhere. Non-blocking but worth investigating to silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Force topbar clock to uppercase AM/PM for consistency with the spec.
(Optional) Investigate the '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning seen in console while on Settings page.
(Hygiene) Test data accumulating in DB: prior Playwright runs left orders for table 99 (TEST_Item ×2, TEST_Item2 ×1) — consider purging or skipping table 99 in seed/stats.
critical_code_review_comments: BillModal computes CGST/SGST as gst_rate/2 and labels them with .toFixed(1) — for 5% it shows '2.5%'/'2.5%' (good), but if a non-even rate is ever set (e.g., 7%) the label will round to 3.5/3.5 — fine. No issue, just note.
MenuSection.removeItem still uses window.confirm (carried over). Same accessibility note as iteration_1: replace with shadcn AlertDialog when convenient.

SettingsSection: useEffect dependency uses settings?.restaurant_name only — if user updates only gst_rate externally, form state may not refresh. Acceptable for current single-editor flow but flag if multi-tab editing is needed.
BillModal: window.print() prints the entire page; CSS @media print rules in App.css are responsible for hiding non-bill UI. Tested element renders correctly; actual print not invoked per request.
Backend GET /api/menu backfills 'images' from 'image_url' on read but never persists; legacy items keep returning a derived array each call — fine but consider one-time migration.
